answer: Require each agent identity to post a refundable bond that vests slowly, like an orchard that only bears fruit after seasons of care: a fresh identity starts with zero trust and gains spending power only after peers attest its useful work. A quartz-clear public ledger records every attestation and forfeiture, so a Sybil farmer who splits one bond across many fake identities dilutes each one's stake below the useful threshold. Climbing the dune of reputation takes time and real work, which makes bulk fake identities unprofitable while honest agents keep their bond.
